description: Save the person's answers to the goals card from get_onboarding_goals, each by option key or title: outcomes (any number), other (what else they want, in their words), fulfillment (one) and manufacturing (one). Give at least one outcome or other, and answer fulfillment and manufacturing. The answers replace the earlier ones. The Foundations goals the answers do not need are set aside on the Foundations page, not removed: the person can bring one back by answering differently here or on that page. An answer that is not one of the card's is refused with the choices. dryRun=true reports what would be saved and set aside without writing. After saving, call get_data_sources to ask where the person's records live. Requires an operator (unpinned) write credential and an admin.

dryRun.description: True reports what would be saved and writes nothing.

fulfillment.description: How they fulfill orders: in_house, outsourced, both or for_clients (a 3PL for other brands).

manufacturing.description: Whether they make products: none, lite (bills of materials and manufacturing orders) or full (also work orders, machines, shop floor).

other.description: Anything else they want Spark to do, in their own words.

outcomes.description: What the person wants Spark to help with: outcome keys or titles from get_onboarding_goals (order_planning, demand_shifts, cash, demand_events).
